statement: Every real residual has an interior quantile coordinate at nonpositive shape.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {l : ℝ} (hl : l ≤ 0) (z : ℝ) : ∃ p ∈ Ioo 0 1, Q l p = z

statement: At fixed shape the probability weight is continuous on the closed unit interval.
Every positive superlevel is compact with shape and scale held.
At nonpositive shape attainment is automatic, and at positive shape it is equivalent to exact support compatibility.
Infinite location has zero envelope, and absence of a positive-likelihood fit is exactly support incompatibility.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {l s : ℝ}
    (hs : 0 < s) (i j : Fin n) (hi : ∀ k, x i ≤ x k) (hj : ∀ k, x k ≤ x j) :
    (∀ c > 0, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ q ∈ graph x l s, M < |q.1| → graphLikelihood l s q < c) ∧
    ((¬ ∃ q ∈ graph x l s, 0 < graphLikelihood l s q ∧
      IsMaxOn (graphLikelihood l s) (graph x l s) q) ↔
      (¬ ∃ q ∈ graph x l s, 0 < graphLikelihood l s q)) ∧
    ((¬ ∃ q ∈ graph x l s, 0 < graphLikelihood l s q) ↔
      0 < l ∧ (if l < 1 then 2*(s/l) ≤ x j-x i else 2*(s/l) < x j-x i))

statement: The fitted held-scale graph has compact positive superlevels, including when shape and support contacts move jointly.
Every finite nonempty sample has a positive maximum at an eligible finite shape and location.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) {s : ℝ}
    (hs : 0 < s) :
    ∃ q ∈ fittedGraph x s, 0 < fittedLikelihood s q ∧
      IsMaxOn (fittedLikelihood s) (fittedGraph x s) q

statement: Infinite location has zero envelope, and both shape endpoints and closed support contacts belong to the finite graph.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) {s : ℝ}
    (hs : 0 < s) :
    (∀ c > 0, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ q ∈ fittedGraph x s, M < |q.2.1| → fittedLikelihood s q < c) ∧
    (∀ m : ℝ, ∃ p : Fin n → ℝ, (-1,m,p) ∈ fittedGraph x s ∧
      0 < fittedLikelihood s (-1,m,p)) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ m : ℝ,
      (∃! p : Fin n → ℝ, (l,m,p) ∈ fittedGraph x s) ↔ ∀ j, |x j-m| ≤ s/l)

statement: At a negative held shape, scale attainment is equivalent to a positive collapse exponent.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ) (hn : 0 < n)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    (∃ s > 0, ∃ p : Fin n → ℝ, (m,p) ∈ graph x (-a) s ∧ 0 < graphLikelihood (-a) s (m,p) ∧
      ∀ t > 0, ∀ q : Fin n → ℝ, (m,q) ∈ graph x (-a) t →
        graphLikelihood (-a) t (m,q) ≤ graphLikelihood (-a) s (m,p)) ↔
    0 < ((n : ℝ)-multiplicity x m)/a - multiplicity x m

statement: The joined scale attainment criterion covers negative, logistic, and positive held shape.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m l : ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (∃ s > 0, ∃ p : Fin n → ℝ, (m,p) ∈ graph x l s ∧ 0 < graphLikelihood l s (m,p) ∧
      ∀ t > 0, ∀ q : Fin n → ℝ, (m,q) ∈ graph x l t →
        graphLikelihood l t (m,q) ≤ graphLikelihood l s (m,p)) ↔
    if l < 0 then 0 < ((n : ℝ)-multiplicity x m)/(-l) - multiplicity x m else
      ∃ i, x i ≠ m

statement: Infinite scale has zero envelope and the joined zero-scale classification gives zero, infinity, or the precise unattained critical value.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m l : ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (∀ c > 0, ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ s > R, ∀ p : Fin n → ℝ, (m,p) ∈ graph x l s →
      graphLikelihood l s (m,p) < c) ∧
    (if l < 0 then
      let e : ℝ := ((n : ℝ)-multiplicity x m)/(-l) - multiplicity x m
      (0 < e → Vanishes x m l) ∧ (e < 0 → Diverges x m l) ∧
      (e = 0 →
        let B := ∏ j, if x j = m then weight l (1/2) else
          1/((-l)*|x j-m|)^(((-l)+1)/(-l))
        let D : Set (ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ)) := {q | 0 < q.1 ∧ (m,q.2) ∈ graph x l q.1}
        let L : ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ := fun q ↦ graphLikelihood l q.1 (m,q.2)
        sSup (L '' D) = B ∧ (∀ q ∈ D, L q < B) ∧
          ∃ p : ℝ → Fin n → ℝ, (∀ s > 0, (m,p s) ∈ graph x l s) ∧
            Tendsto (fun s ↦ graphLikelihood l s (m,p s)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 B))
    else
      ((∃ i, x i ≠ m) → Vanishes x m l) ∧ ((∀ i, x i = m) → Diverges x m l))

statement: The negative-shape tail factor converges to its strict finite-scale bound after normalization.
The fixed-location normalized likelihood converges to the exact collapse coefficient and is strictly below it when a residual is nonzero.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ) {a : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (p : ℝ → Fin n → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ s > 0, (m,p s) ∈ graph x (-a) s) :
    let e : ℝ := ((n : ℝ)-multiplicity x m)/a - multiplicity x m
    let B := ∏ j, if x j = m then weight (-a) (1/2) else
      1/(a*|x j-m|)^((a+1)/a)
    (∀ s > 0, (∃ j, x j ≠ m) → graphLikelihood (-a) s (m,p s)/s^e < B) ∧
    Tendsto (fun s ↦ graphLikelihood (-a) s (m,p s)/s^e) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 B)

statement: At the critical exponent the collapse coefficient is the supremum and every positive scale is strictly below it.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ) (hn : 0 < n)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (he : ((n : ℝ)-multiplicity x m)/a - multiplicity x m = 0) :
    let B := ∏ j, if x j = m then weight (-a) (1/2) else
      1/(a*|x j-m|)^((a+1)/a)
    let D : Set (ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ)) := {q | 0 < q.1 ∧ (m,q.2) ∈ graph x (-a) q.1}
    let L : ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ := fun q ↦ graphLikelihood (-a) q.1 (m,q.2)
    sSup (L '' D) = B ∧ ∀ q ∈ D, L q < B

statement: A negative exponent gives arbitrary likelihood at arbitrarily small positive scales.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ) {a : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (he : ((n : ℝ) - multiplicity x m)/a - multiplicity x m < 0) :
    ∀ B : ℝ, ∀ δ > (0 : ℝ), ∃ s ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ, ∃ p : Fin n → ℝ,
      (m,p) ∈ graph x (-a) s ∧ B < graphLikelihood (-a) s (m,p)

statement: A strict majority atom gives unrestricted growth at arbitrarily small scale already at fitted shape minus one.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ)
    (h : (n : ℝ) < 2 * multiplicity x m) :
    ∀ B : ℝ, ∀ δ > (0 : ℝ), ∃ s ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ, ∃ p : Fin n → ℝ,
      (m,p) ∈ graph x (-1) s ∧ B < graphLikelihood (-1) s (m,p)

statement: A tie at held location gives infinite envelope at the joint infinite-negative-shape and zero-scale corner.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ)
    (i : Fin n) (hi : x i = m) :
    ∀ A B : ℝ, ∀ δ > (0 : ℝ), ∃ a > A, 0 < a ∧
      ∃ s ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ, ∃ p : Fin n → ℝ,
        (m,p) ∈ graph x (-a) s ∧ B < graphLikelihood (-a) s (m,p)

statement: Approaching a finite critical shape from more negative shapes gives infinite joint envelope at zero scale.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ) {a₀ : ℝ}
    (h₀ : 0 < a₀) (hk : 0 < multiplicity x m)
    (he : ((n : ℝ)-multiplicity x m)/a₀ - multiplicity x m = 0) :
    ∀ B : ℝ, ∀ δ > (0 : ℝ), ∃ a ∈ Ioo a₀ (a₀+δ),
      ∃ s ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ, ∃ p : Fin n → ℝ,
        (m,p) ∈ graph x (-a) s ∧ B < graphLikelihood (-a) s (m,p)

statement: With unrestricted shape every nonempty sample gives unbounded likelihood through positive shapes.
hypotheses_and_conclusion:
{n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    ∀ B : ℝ, ∃ l > 1, ∃ s > 0, ∃ p : Fin n → ℝ,
      (x i,p) ∈ heldScaleGraph x l s ∧ B < graphLikelihood l s (x i,p)
